name: Hints of a New Plague?
summary: In Arathi, Quae and Kinelory stay while you carry news to Southshore. Quae has the items from the farm, and Kinelory has returned safely.

sections.title: Word for Southshore
sections.body: Quae is pleased with how you cared for Kinelory. She says Kinelory is in better shape than after a night at the tavern. The items from the farm should help Phin Odelic understand what is happening in Arathi. Since the farm was attacked, Quae and Kinelory plan to stay there a little longer in case anyone retaliates. They ask you to return to Southshore and speak with Phin.

sections.title: Phin's Answer
sections.body: Phin is glad to hear that Quae and Kinelory are alive and well. He calls them irreplaceable friends and travelling companions. On behalf of the whole group, Phin thanks you with a gift. He hopes that, with luck, they will learn what the Forsaken are planning and bring it to an end.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Phin Odelic?
aliases: who gives hints of a new plague 5
who starts hints of a new plague
faq.answer: Quae asks you to go to Southshore once Kinelory is safely back from the farm.

faq.q: Why aren't Quae and Kinelory returning to Southshore themselves?
aliases: why is quae staying in arathi
faq.answer: Quae and Kinelory plan to stay in Arathi a little longer in case anyone retaliates for the attack on the farm.

faq.q: Where can Phin Odelic be found?
What is the purpose of bringing news to Phin Odelic?
faq.answer: The items Kinelory brought from the farm should help Phin Odelic understand what is happening in Arathi.
